name: h
description: GitHub-installed Kie-only batch and single workflow with automatic runtime setup.

interface.shortDescription: GitHub-installed fixed Kie workflows with automatic setup.
interface.longDescription: H installs from its GitHub marketplace and runs Kie-only workflows through one deterministic Chinese menu protocol with two modes: recursive whole-folder concurrent batch processing and one-model single processing. On first use it detects the platform and, when no suitable Python exists, downloads and verifies the matching Windows, Intel Mac, or Apple Silicon runtime from the same GitHub repository. It validates Kie before generation, saves task IDs for safe resume, validates downloaded media, and writes Desktop text, image, and video folders.
defaultPrompt: 使用 H 批量处理整个 PID 产品文件夹。
使用 H 单独调用一个 Kie 文本、图像或视频模型。
使用 H 继续已保存的 Kie 生成任务。
